bio: Mountain-bike lines through Polish forests and Alpine passes. Mud, roots and the last light of the ride.
avatar: Portrait of a man in his early 30s with a helmet and sport sunglasses pushed up, mud splashes on his face, big grin, forest light, shoulders-up, photographic, fictional person
banner: Ultra-wide panoramic photograph of a mountain bike trail winding through a misty pine forest with a lone rider far away, subject across the middle band, cinematic

collections.title: Lines & climbs
collections.description: From forest trails to Alpine passes.

videos.title: Forest descent, roots and mud
videos.description: A fast line through wet pine forest.
videos.still: Vertical low-angle photograph of a mountain biker seen from behind riding down a muddy forest trail among pine roots, mist and golden light, no face, no text
videos.motion: The rider descends fast in a spray of mud, trees rush past, steady low camera follow.

videos.title: Alpine pass at sunrise
videos.description: A road bike climbing above the clouds.
videos.still: Wide photograph of a cyclist far away on a winding Alpine mountain road at sunrise above a sea of clouds, long shadows, no face, no text
videos.motion: The cyclist climbs slowly along the road and clouds roll in the valley, golden light grows, gentle camera drift.

videos.title: Chain, grease, 6 a.m.
videos.description: A bike on a stand and a chain getting its care.
videos.still: Vertical close-up photograph of a hand applying lubricant to a bicycle chain on a repair stand, workshop light, no face, no text
videos.motion: The pedal turns slowly and the chain glistens, subtle macro drift.

videos.title: Gravel at golden hour
videos.description: Dust and low sun on a long gravel road.
videos.still: Wide photograph of two gravel cyclists seen from behind riding down a long dusty dirt road through golden fields at sunset, no faces, no text
videos.motion: Dust rises behind the riders in the golden light, the road stretches ahead, slow camera follow.

stories.still: Vertical photograph of mud-caked mountain bike tyres leaning against a wooden fence, no people, no text

stories.still: Vertical photograph of a bike helmet and a paper map on a wooden table beside a window, no text

stories.caption: Summit selfie, no selfie
